question: How do I place an order?
answer: Add items to your cart, go to checkout, enter your delivery address, choose a payment method and confirm. You will receive a confirmation email with your order number.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel an order from My Orders until it has been shipped. After it ships it cannot be cancelled, but you can return it once it is delivered.

question: Can I change the items in my order after placing it?
answer: Items, size or colour can only be changed before the order is shipped. Contact support quickly with your order number.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Open My Orders and select the order to see its tracking status. A tracking link is also sent by email and SMS once your order ships.

question: I did not receive an order confirmation email.
answer: Check your spam folder first. If it is not there, look in My Orders: if the order is listed, it was placed successfully.

question: What happens if an item is out of stock?
answer: Out-of-stock items cannot be ordered. Use Notify Me on the product page to get an email when the item is back in stock.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit and debit cards, bank transfer, digital wallets, and cash on delivery for eligible orders.

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Cash on delivery is available for eligible orders. You will see the option at checkout if your order qualifies.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted.
answer: If money was deducted but the order shows as unpaid, it is usually reversed automatically within 5 to 7 working days. If it is not, contact support with your transaction ID.

question: Is it safe to pay online?
answer: Payments are processed over encrypted connections, and we do not store your full card number.

question: Can I get an invoice or receipt?
answer: An invoice is emailed after payment and can be downloaded from My Orders at any time.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Common reasons are incorrect card details, insufficient balance or a security block by your bank. Check your details and try again, contact your bank, or use another payment method.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 7 working days depending on your city. The estimated date is shown at checkout.

question: How much is the delivery fee?
answer: The delivery fee is calculated at checkout based on your location and order size. Some orders qualify for free delivery.

question: My order is delayed. What should I do?
answer: First check live tracking in My Orders. If your order is more than 2 days past the estimated date, contact support with your order number.

question: Do you deliver to my area?
answer: Enter your address or postal code at checkout. If we deliver to your area, the available delivery options will appear.

question: What if I am not home when the courier arrives?
answer: The courier will try to deliver again. If delivery keeps failing, the order is returned to us and our team will contact you.

question: My package arrived damaged.
answer: Take photos of the parcel and the item, then contact support within 48 hours of delivery with your order number so we can arrange a replacement or refund.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original packaging.

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, choose Return and pick a reason. We will arrange a pickup or tell you where to send the item.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Perishable goods, innerwear and personalised items cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged or incorrect.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
answer: Exchanges for a different size or colour are possible within the return window, subject to stock availability.

question: I received the wrong item.
answer: Contact support within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the item. We will arrange a replacement or refund at no cost to you.

question: Who pays for return shipping?
answer: Return shipping is free if the item is damaged, defective or incorrect. For other returns a pickup fee may apply.

question: How do I get a refund?
answer: Once your return is approved and received, the refund is started automatically to your original payment method. You do not need to make a separate request.

question: Will I get a refund for a cancelled order?
answer: Yes. Orders cancelled before shipping are refunded in full to the original payment method.

question: Can I get store credit instead of a refund?
answer: Yes. Choose store credit when you return an item and it will be added to your account.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds usually reach your account within 5 to 7 working days after we receive the returned item. Your bank may take a little longer to show it.

question: Why have I not received my refund yet?
answer: First check that 7 working days have passed since we received the item, then check your bank statement. If it is still missing, contact support with your order number and return ID.

question: Are delivery fees refundable?
answer: Delivery fees are refunded only if the whole order is cancelled before shipping or if the item was incorrect or damaged.

question: Where does my refund go?
answer: Refunds go back to your original payment method. For cash on delivery orders we refund to a bank account or wallet that you provide.
